metrics.title: Weekly Activated Organizations
metrics.definition: Distinct organizations completing the event selected by the effective activation-definition version during a calendar week.

metrics.title: Signup to activation conversion
metrics.definition: Accounts with activation_achieved divided by accounts with account_created in the selected signup cohort.

metrics.title: Time to first value
metrics.definition: Median and p90 elapsed time from account_created to the first activation_achieved for the account organization.

metrics.title: MRR waterfall
metrics.definition: Opening MRR plus new, expansion, and reactivated MRR minus contraction and churned MRR equals closing MRR.

metrics.title: Critical reliability
metrics.definition: Current SLO burn, dead letters, analytics export lag, and reconciliation discrepancies.

metrics.title: Acquisition funnel
metrics.definition: Unique identities progressing through landing, waitlist, signup, account creation, and activation facts in order.

metrics.title: Activation by campaign
metrics.definition: Signup and activation counts segmented independently by immutable first-touch and mutable last-touch source and campaign.

metrics.title: Invitation funnel
metrics.definition: Distinct invitations progressing through created, delivered, opened, and accepted server or consented browser facts.

metrics.title: Step completion and drop-off
metrics.definition: Distinct onboarding identities viewing, completing, or skipping each step by flow version.

metrics.title: Onboarding time to value
metrics.definition: Elapsed time from onboarding_started to activation_achieved, segmented by flow version and variant.

metrics.title: Activation after onboarding
metrics.definition: Organizations achieving activation after onboarding_completed divided by organizations completing onboarding.

metrics.title: Active users and organizations
metrics.definition: Distinct users and organizations with at least one registered qualifying product-value event in the selected period.

metrics.title: DAU, WAU, and MAU
metrics.definition: Distinct active users and organizations in rolling 1, 7, and 30 day UTC windows; stickiness is WAU divided by MAU.

metrics.title: Core-action frequency
metrics.definition: Count and active-day distribution of deduplicated core_action_completed facts per active organization.

metrics.title: Lifecycle
metrics.definition: New, retained, resurrected, and dormant identities based on activity in the current and preceding equal period.

metrics.title: User and organization cohorts
metrics.definition: Percent of each signup or activation cohort returning with a qualifying value event in subsequent week or month offsets.

metrics.title: Logo and revenue retention
metrics.definition: Retained paying organizations and recurring revenue from the opening cohort, excluding new business.

metrics.title: Churn by cause
metrics.definition: Churned organizations and MRR split by explicit voluntary cancellation versus failed-payment exhaustion.

metrics.title: Pre-churn signals
metrics.definition: Product usage, support, and feedback facts in the 30 days preceding a churn movement.

metrics.title: MRR and ARR
metrics.definition: Normalized recurring subscription value at month end; ARR is closing MRR multiplied by 12.

metrics.title: MRR movements
metrics.definition: New, expansion, contraction, churned, and reactivated MRR classified by consecutive organization-month snapshots.

metrics.title: GRR and NRR
metrics.definition: GRR excludes expansion and new business; NRR adds expansion and reactivation to opening recurring revenue while excluding new business.

metrics.title: ARPA and concentration
metrics.definition: Closing MRR per paying organization and the share of closing MRR held by the largest organizations.

metrics.title: Trial conversion
metrics.definition: Organizations reaching subscription_started after trial_started, with elapsed-time distribution.

metrics.title: Usage history
metrics.definition: Accepted immutable usage-event quantity bucketed in UTC for each catalogued customer-visible meter.

metrics.title: Limit headroom
metrics.definition: Current accepted monthly quantity compared with the effective plan or organization override limit.

metrics.title: Near-limit forecast
metrics.definition: Current-period quantity projected linearly across the remaining UTC billing period and compared with the effective limit.

metrics.title: Reconciliation discrepancy
metrics.definition: Difference between immutable accepted usage-event sums, usage totals, and configured provider-reported quantity.

metrics.title: Core journey SLOs
metrics.definition: Availability, latency, and error budget burn for signup, login, invitation acceptance, checkout, core action, notification delivery, event export, and usage consumption.

metrics.title: Jobs and integrations
metrics.definition: Durable queue depth, oldest ready age, retries, dead letters, expired leases, and low-cardinality worker outcomes.

metrics.title: Analytics delivery
metrics.definition: Analytics queue depth, oldest-event age, retries, schema rejects, idempotency conflicts, terminal failures, and provider latency.

metrics.title: Source freshness
metrics.definition: Elapsed time since the latest successful source observation compared with each card's refresh expectation.
